site.tagline: An OS sandbox for AI coding agents
site.description: ai-jail runs Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding agents inside an OS sandbox on Linux and macOS. The project stays writable. Your keys, tokens and home directory stay out of reach.
site.ogAlt: The ai-jail logo: a padlock made of circuit traces with a microchip behind bars
